column4: 瀕死になるレイ、くそっと逃げて行く
column5: Lei becomes near death and damn it, flees away.

column4: 最後の力を振り絞って、周囲の人類軍に雷撃を落としその煙と混乱の中を走り抜ける
column5: Summoning his last strength, he strikes lightning on the surrounding human army and runs through the smoke and confusion.

column4: ランスは全軍に指示、追いかけろ・・捕まえろ、殺す事は俺にしか出来ないがな
column5: Rance orders the entire army: chase him... capture him, only I can kill him though.
Do not let him escape under any circumstances.
